summary.statement: Checked formal and executable properties apply only to their recorded premises and domains. Legal source meaning, completeness and unknown future legal situations remain qualified.

fact_classifications.meaning: The fund is a UCITS domiciled in France, Luxembourg, Ireland or the Netherlands, or a UK-domiciled collective investment scheme authorised as UK UCITS.
fact_classifications.name: defined_ucits_fund

fact_classifications.meaning: The selected change is a post-authorisation matter for the fund.
fact_classifications.name: post_authorisation_change

fact_classifications.meaning: The selected change is material and concerns the fund's investment objective, policy or restriction.
fact_classifications.name: material_investment_change

fact_classifications.meaning: Date as of which availability of the selected removal of prior approval is assessed.
fact_classifications.name: assessment_date

fact_classifications.meaning: The selected change complies with the fund's applicable home-jurisdiction requirements.
fact_classifications.name: home_requirements_met

fact_classifications.meaning: The selected change involves novel product features.
fact_classifications.name: novel_features

fact_classifications.meaning: The selected change involves complex product features.
fact_classifications.name: complex_features

fact_classifications.meaning: The selected change may have local policy implications; this asks about possibility, not only established actual effects.
fact_classifications.name: possible_local_policy_implications

fact_classifications.meaning: An application concerning the selected change was received by the SFC before 28 November 2025 and had received neither approval nor authorisation by that date.
fact_classifications.name: pending_pre_effective_application

reading_assumptions: The express circular-specific definition is exhaustive for this measure; ordinary or broader uses of UCITS do not expand it.
Home-regulator supervision in the introduction describes the purpose; item (ii)'s express condition is home-jurisdiction compliance. Item (i)'s separate supervision condition is not imported.
The express Effective Date governs the introductory immediate-effect wording.
Pending application status is assessed at the Effective Date.
Preservation of the existing process excludes the pending application from this removal, without determining the full contents of that process.
The identified change is assessed as a whole; no severability rule is inferred.
This proposal remains subject to qualifications in unavailable referenced materials.
reading_questions: Can an item (ii) change comply with home requirements while falling outside home-regulator supervision, and do the FAQs address that case?
Does 'existing approval or authorisation process' preserve the substantive prior-approval requirement for the selected pending application?
Which additional authorities determine whether prior approval is legally required when this limited removal is unavailable?
